Handling of Watchdog after Startup
⌈
Plat-
form Health Management
shall call
WatchdogInterface::AliveNotifi-
cation
before reporting
kRunning
to Execution Management using the
method
ara::exec::ExecutionClient::ReportExecutionState
.
⌋
(RS_HM_-
09249, RS_HM_09244, RS_HM_09245, RS_HM_09246)
The intention is to take over the control of the HW watchdog as early as possible.
More information on the machine startup sequence can be found in [11].
7.8.2 Shutdown
It is the integrators responsibility to make correct use of the shutdown mechanism. De-
tails for ensuring safe execution are given in [14]. Details on the sequence of machine
shutdown can be found in [11].
